introduction.zh: 你更愿意用现有办法、说明持续安排、专看明确一步、表达共同意见、分享具体经验、开始学一点，还是问最初假设？21道原创题借原版三部曲出现的七位角色，比较普通自选做法。不是剧情考题、原力测试或心理病理分类，七份完整结果可先读，最高并列全部完整显示。
introduction.en: Would you rather work with available means, describe continuation, take one clear step, express shared views, offer experience, begin learning or question an assumption? Twenty-one original items use seven characters appearing in the original trilogy for ordinary chosen approaches. This is no trivia, Force test or psychopathology taxonomy. Read all seven guides first and see every highest tie in full.

instructions.zh: 21道原创非官方同人题，选用在《星球大战》原版三部曲出现的汉·索罗、帕尔帕廷、达斯·维达、莱娅、欧比旺、卢克和尤达七位虚构角色，比较普通自选做法。每题从四种做法选一个较接近自己的，均以自愿、许可、可改和可停止为前提。每选加1，每位出现12次、每位置3次，总数21；最高并列全部完整显示。帕尔帕廷与西迪厄斯、维达与阿纳金各是一位身份，不另增角色。无需剧情知识，不测原力、心理病理、智商、善恶、危险性、身体、族群、性别或职业，不要求模仿战争、武器、操控、伤害或修行，也不换算MBTI；不是Disney或Lucasfilm官方测验。
instructions.en: Twenty-one original unofficial fan questions select seven characters appearing in the original Star Wars trilogy: Han, Palpatine, Vader, Leia, Obi-Wan, Luke and Yoda. Compare ordinary chosen approaches by selecting the closer of four options in voluntary, permitted, revisable and stoppable situations. Each choice adds one, each character appears twelve times and three times per position, and counts sum to twenty-one. Every highest tie appears in full. Palpatine and Sidious are one identity, as are Vader and Anakin, rather than extra characters. No episode knowledge is needed. There is no Force, psychopathology, IQ, good-versus-evil, dangerousness, bodily, ethnicity, gender or career assessment, imitation of war, weapons, manipulation, harm or spiritual training, or MBTI conversion. This is no official Disney or Lucasfilm test.

scoreReading.zh: 21题全部各选一项，对应的本版角色读法加1，总数固定21。每题提供七位中的四位，全卷每位出现12次、每位置3次；未提供的三位不记拒绝。所有最高计数逐份保留完整说明，全选第一项会七位各3次、七份完整显示。顺序不设主次，不自动指定第二角色；原始次数不是相似百分比、真实人格比例、原力、善恶或人口排名。相差一次只是一项选择，不证明显著差异、隐藏身份或固定类型。近分可自行比较，不补造并列、能力、阵营或种族。条件和理解可以改变选择，本版没有常模、稀有度、科学分界或心理测量验证。
scoreReading.en: Choose one option for all 21 items; each adds one to its editorial character reading and counts sum to 21. Four of seven characters are offered per item. Each appears twelve times and three times in each position; three absent options are not rejections. Every highest count keeps its full guide. Choosing the first option throughout gives three each and all seven guides. List order establishes no priority or automatic second character. Counts are neither similarity percentages, actual personality proportions, the Force, good-versus-evil nor population ranks. One extra choice proves no significance, hidden identity or fixed type. Read close guides without inventing ties, powers, alignments or species. Conditions and understanding can change choices; this edition has no norms, rarity estimates, scientific cutoffs or psychometric validation.

title.zh: 角色背景与本版有限读法
title.en: Character context and this edition’s limited reading

paragraphs.zh: 官方资料中的汉是千年隼船长，与丘巴卡、卢克和莱娅有重要联系。本站选“使用眼前可用的办法”的普通角度，不把全部经历变成自由、冒险或嘴快的赞歌。临时变通限于自己获准的小事，角色的走私、射击、赌局与危险经历不构成现实建议，也不证明答题者有同样技能。
paragraphs.en: Official context identifies Han as the Millennium Falcon’s captain, connected with Chewbacca, Luke and Leia. This edition selects working with available means without making his entire story a celebration of freedom, risk or quick words. Adjustments concern permitted ordinary activities. Smuggling, shooting, gambling and danger prescribe no actual conduct and establish no comparable skill in someone receiving this limited fan reading.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择先看手边有什么，组合一个暂时够用的办法。可以问：你喜欢临时组合，还是当前确实没有原材料？计数不观察方法是否安全、有效或聪明。够用可以很简单，也可以最后决定不做；缺少条件不要求靠冒险、隐瞒或借用未经许可的东西补齐。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to inspect what is at hand and combine an adequate approach for now. Does improvising appeal, or is the original material simply absent? Counts observe no safety, effectiveness or cleverness. Adequacy can be simple and may end in not proceeding. Missing conditions require neither risks, concealment nor borrowing something without actual permission.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，为自己的普通小卡临时少了一种装饰，可以用已有纸片换一个布局，也可以直接留白。先确认这些材料属于自己可用范围，不为了完成而拆别人的物品。这个例子让变通有条件，不以惊险、速度、别人称赞或完成一切来认证机智；改回原计划或等材料齐了再做都合理。
paragraphs.en: If a decoration is missing for your own ordinary card, use available paper for another layout or leave space blank. Check that the material is yours to use rather than dismantling somebody’s belongings to finish. The example bounds improvisation without certifying resourcefulness through drama, speed, praise or completing everything. Restore the original plan or wait for suitable materials if preferred.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.en: Official context identifies Vader as the former Anakin, later a Sith serving the Empire. This edition selects one clear chosen step without recasting violence and fear as admirable execution. Vader and Anakin remain one character identity. Clothing, voice, technological body and scars assign no actual bodily condition, psychology or morality to respondents and are never inputs to this limited reading.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择一个自己确定愿意做的小步骤，先不切换或扩大。可以问：这一部份仍由自己选择吗，停止处是否清楚？计数不观察注意力、实际完成或效率。明确一步可以做完、暂放或改变，不代表必须听命执行，也不要求排除别人意见；一个选择不能说明你会把所有事情贯彻到底。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose one wanted step without switching or expanding for now. Does it remain chosen, and is its endpoint clear? Counts observe neither attention, completion nor efficiency. Finish, pause or change the step. Clarity requires neither obedience nor exclusion of others’ views, and a choice shows no universal tendency to carry everything through regardless of circumstances.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，整理一小块自己可用空间，可以只选“把这三张卡放到同一处”，到这里就停，不扩成全屋整理。若发现卡片属于别人，就先问许可；若今天不想做，也可以留着。这个例子把明确对象与许可分开，不以速度、从不分心、让别人配合或最后整齐程度认证执行能力，也不制造必须完成的命令。
paragraphs.en: For a small space you may use, choose putting three cards together and stop there rather than expanding into a whole-room task. Ask permission for somebody else’s cards or leave the step today. The example distinguishes a clear object from actual permission without certifying execution through speed, uninterrupted attention, cooperation or neatness. A clear step creates no order that must be obeyed.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我现在只想做这一步，到这里结束；如果条件变了，我也可以改。”若别人一起参与，说明这是自己的选择，不替他们下达任务。你能接受不同看法、请人说明或不继续，不需要因为结果像维达就表现强硬。坚定语气也不使拒绝失效，更不能用角色名合理化威胁、惩罚或压制。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want only this step now and will finish here; I can change it if conditions change.” State your choice rather than assigning tasks to anyone involved. Hear different views, ask for explanation or stop without performed toughness. A firm tone cancels no refusal, and a character name justifies neither threats, punishment nor silencing another person’s actual wishes.

title.en: Comparisons with the other six character readings

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.en: Staying with a step may follow limited time; switching may follow another important need. Counts establish no obedience, attention disorder, violence, fear, trauma, disability, breathing condition, gender, morality or dangerousness and connect no actual body with fictional villainy. description.en: Read Obi-Wan through one paper-use experience, its limits and six comparisons. No wisdom, teaching authority, prediction or Force power is certified.

title.zh: 角色背景与本版有限读法
title.en: Character context and this edition’s limited reading

paragraphs.zh: 官方资料中的欧比旺曾指导阿纳金与卢克。本站只选“别人需要时分享一项具体经验”的普通角度，不把绝地身份、年资或虚构智慧作为现实权威。这里分享的是自己确实试过的小事，需对方愿意听，也可以只供参考；不要求代替别人学习、作决定或成为所有人的导师，更不将人物经历当作现实人生答案。
paragraphs.en: Official context identifies Obi-Wan as a guide to Anakin and Luke. This edition selects offering one specific experience when wanted without making Jedi status, seniority or fictional wisdom actual authority. Share an ordinary thing you tried with someone willing to hear it. It may remain only a reference, without taking over learning, decisions or a permanent mentor role in another person’s life.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择先问需不需要，再说一次实际情况与局限。可以问：你是在提供一个例子，还是把自己的经验当普遍正确？计数不能回答，也不检查记忆是否准确。对方不采用不代表不尊重，你也可以承认没有经验；分享不等于负责保证效果，过去可行的办法在当前条件下仍需另看。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to check interest before describing one actual case and its limits. Is it an example or an assumed universal answer? Counts cannot establish that or verify memory. Declining it is no disrespect, and you may have no experience. Sharing guarantees no outcome; a method that once fitted still needs consideration under present conditions.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，朋友问一种普通纸张怎样用过，你可以说明曾拿它做可移除的页签，但只试过某种厚度，不知道其他情况。先确认对方想听这一点，不接着替他完成。这个例子把实际尝试、材料条件和未知处分开，不以帮助多少人、说得像老师或是否被采纳来认证智慧，也不让对方为了相信你而放弃自己的判断。
paragraphs.en: If a friend asks about ordinary paper, describe using one thickness as a removable page marker and admit uncertainty about others. Check that this is wanted without taking over the task. The example separates actual experience, conditions and unknowns. Numbers helped, a teacher-like manner and adoption certify no wisdom and require no surrender of the other person’s judgement to demonstrate trust in you.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我试过的是这一种情况，愿意的话可以听听；现在是否适合你，还要看实际条件。”对方可以不想听或选择不同办法，你也可以到此结束。不要把经验说成必须遵守的教训，也不靠人物式的神秘感隐藏不确定。普通分享可以简短，不需要承担结果或证明自己永远值得信任。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “This is the situation I tried, if you want to hear it; whether it fits you depends on present conditions.” Accept no interest or another approach and finish there. Experience is no compulsory lesson, and mystery conceals no uncertainty. Ordinary sharing may be brief without responsibility for the result or proof that you must always be trusted.

title.zh: 与其他六位角色读法比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other six character readings

paragraphs.zh: 欧比旺读法偏分享具体经验，卢克偏自选开始学一点，尤达偏停下问初始假设；分享、学习和提问不设师生高低。汉偏可用办法，帕尔帕廷偏持续安排，维达偏明确一步，莱娅偏共同意见。七种没有年龄、智慧、老师身份或道德等级，也不将最高并列转换为你在现实群体中应当扮演的角色。
paragraphs.en: This Obi-Wan angle concerns specific experience, Luke a chosen learning beginning and Yoda questioning an assumption. Sharing, learning and questions establish no teacher–student hierarchy. Han concerns available means, Palpatine continuation, Vader one step and Leia shared views. The seven rank neither age, wisdom, teaching status nor morality, and a highest tie assigns no permanent real-world role within an actual group or relationship.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，愿意讲经验可能因为刚好被问到，不讲可能因为条件不同、不确定或不想参与。计数不认证智慧、教学、预测、心理洞察、原力、成熟度或职业，也不判断你有没有承担导师责任。现实经验需要真实条件与许可，不由一句虚构格言保证；更不能因别人像欧比旺就默认他应当指导你或替你决定。
paragraphs.en: Sharing may follow being asked; no sharing may reflect different conditions, uncertainty or no wish to join. Counts certify no wisdom, teaching, prediction, insight, Force power, maturity or career and assign no mentor duty. Actual experience needs actual conditions and permission rather than guarantees from fictional sayings. An Obi-Wan-like person owes neither guidance nor decisions on another person’s behalf in actual life.

title.zh: 可选的小观察
title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：想一项自己真正试过的普通小事，写清“当时条件、自己知道什么、还不知道什么”，可以不分享。没有经验就保留没有，不编例子补齐。不检验是否更会教人，也不寻求认可；观察的是经验怎样有限说明，不要求成为导师或用角色身份让别人信服。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, note conditions, knowledge and uncertainty in an ordinary thing you actually tried, without sharing it. Keep an absence of experience rather than inventing one. Test no teaching improvement and seek no recognition. Notice how experience can be described within limits without becoming a mentor or using fictional identity to make somebody accept your account or advice.

title.zh: 非官方原创版本与来源边界
title.en: Unofficial original edition and source scope

paragraphs.zh: 这是费马独立创作的21题非官方同人问卷，选用在《星球大战》原版三部曲出现的汉·索罗、帕尔帕廷、达斯·维达、莱娅、欧比旺、卢克和尤达七位虚构角色，只作普通自选做法的有限阅读角度，不代表完整人格、全作品阵容或官方分类。维达与阿纳金、帕尔帕廷与西迪厄斯各保留一个身份，不增加角色或测试；官方总传记包含其他时期，不因此将所有时期的行为一概投射到答题者。题目、选项、映射、计数、解释与例子原创，未采用IDR35题、竞品正文／算法、其他价值或病理问卷、电影截图、立绘、台词、字幕、歌词或其他受保护素材。不是Disney或Lucasfilm官方测验，无权利人合作、授权或认可；作品、角色和STAR WARS商标归相应权利人。官方Databank仅核角色基本语境和身份，不验证本站题目、计分或心理解释。中文名为本版编辑采用写法，英文身份稳定。结果不推断原力、心理病理、疾病、智商、道德、危险性、残障、身体、物种、族群、性别、年龄、创伤、爱情、关系、职业或政治信念，不指导战争、武器、操控、虐待、呼吸、冥想或战斗练习，也不换算MBTI或其他测评。
paragraphs.en: This is an independently authored FermatMind 21-item unofficial fan quiz selecting seven characters appearing in the original Star Wars trilogy: Han, Palpatine, Vader, Leia, Obi-Wan, Luke and Yoda. They support limited readings of ordinary chosen approaches rather than complete personalities, the entire franchise cast or an official taxonomy. Vader and Anakin retain one identity, as do Palpatine and Sidious, adding no characters or tests. Official biographies include other periods without projecting every period’s behaviour onto respondents. Items, options, mappings, counts, explanations and examples are original. No IDR 35-item bank, competitor text or algorithm, other values or psychopathology instrument, film stills, character art, dialogue, subtitles, lyrics or other protected material is used. This is no official Disney or Lucasfilm test or rights-holder partnership, authorisation or endorsement; respective owners retain works, characters and STAR WARS trademarks. Official Databank pages check basic context and identities without validating these items, counts or psychology. Chinese names are editorial choices retaining English identities. Results infer no Force, psychopathology, illness, IQ, morality, dangerousness, disability, bodily condition, species, ethnicity, gender, age, trauma, romance, relationship, career or political belief, instruct no war, weapons, manipulation, abuse, breathing, meditation or combat practice, and convert into no MBTI or other assessment.

paragraphs.zh: 官方资料中的卢克从塔图因农场生活走向绝地道路，欧比旺和尤达与他的学习有关。本站只选“迈出自选的学习一步”的普通角度，不把故事宿命、家族或原力当作现实天赋。开始可以很小，也可以不继续；不要求离开原生活、承受危险或克服某段经历来证明成长，人物的全部人生也不由一项学习选择概括。
paragraphs.en: Official context places Luke’s beginning on a Tatooine farm and connects Obi-Wan and Yoda with his learning. This edition selects one chosen learning step without making fictional destiny, family or the Force actual talent. A beginning can be small and need no continuation, life departure or danger as proof of growth. One learning choice summarises neither the character’s whole life nor a respondent’s.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择一个自己想了解的词、例子或小问题，从不熟悉处学一点。可以问：这是自己想知道，还是觉得必须补全所有内容？计数不分辨，也不检查理解或学习效果。愿望、机会和实际能力是不同事情；不知道可以保留，不需要把第一步自动扩成长期目标，也不以快慢判断是否值得学。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose a word, example or little question you want to understand. Is it wanted or felt necessary to complete everything? Counts cannot distinguish or check learning. Wishes, opportunities and actual ability differ. Keep uncertainty without making the first step a long-term goal or judging the value of learning through speed, completeness or whether others already know it.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，看到一个普通兴趣词语，你只想看一个例子，了解大概在说什么，就可以到这里结束。若资料没有说明清楚，标出不知道，而不是猜完整定义；以后愿意再查也可以。这个例子把第一步、资料和未知处分开，不以记得快、坚持多久或是否很快变熟练来认证学习能力，也不要求把每个兴趣发展成身份。
paragraphs.en: For an ordinary hobby term, look at one example to understand roughly what it refers to, then stop. Mark unclear information rather than guessing a full definition; return later if wanted. The example separates a beginning, material and uncertainty without certifying learning ability through recall, endurance or rapid proficiency. An interest need not become an identity, completed course or commitment to keep improving.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“这一点我想先了解一个例子，现在还不知道全部，也不一定继续。”若向别人请教，先问是否方便，不把对方当必须带领自己的老师。你也能自己看看、换资料或停下；慢一点、已经知道或今天不想学，都不与实际意愿矛盾，不需要靠角色式的成长故事替自己定路线。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want one example of this point, without knowing everything or promising to continue.” Ask availability before requesting help rather than making someone your required teacher. Look alone, change material or stop. Slowness, existing knowledge and no wish to learn today need no growth story deciding a route for you in place of actual interests and conditions.

title.zh: 与其他六位角色读法比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other six character readings

paragraphs.zh: 卢克读法偏开始学一点，欧比旺偏需要时分享经验，尤达偏问最初假设；学习不必接受固定导师或同一观点。维达偏明确一步，汉偏可用办法，莱娅偏共同意见，帕尔帕廷偏持续安排。七种没有天赋、勇气、学习能力或正义等级，也不转换本站学习方式问卷、智商或MBTI；最高并列可逐份比较具体关注。
paragraphs.en: This Luke angle concerns learning a little, Obi-Wan wanted experience and Yoda initial assumptions. Learning requires no fixed mentor or shared viewpoint. Vader concerns one step, Han available means, Leia shared views and Palpatine continuation. The seven rank no talent, courage, learning ability or justice and convert into no Learning Style, IQ or MBTI result. Read tied guides for their specific concerns rather than selecting a destiny.

paragraphs.en: A new topic may simply become available; fewer choices may reflect familiarity or no interest. Counts certify no learning ability, willpower, wisdom, ancestry, Force, psychology, trauma, bravery or career and predict no future identity. Actual learning depends on content, conditions and observed performance rather than fictional training, and a Luke result requires no continued pursuit of a growth route you no longer choose.

title.zh: 可选的小观察

paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, note one ordinary question you genuinely want and the smallest way to explore it, including a stopping point. No action, memory test or timed learning is required. Keep no current question if none appears. Notice a chosen beginning without turning curiosity into a duty or borrowing fictional destiny to infer your talent, personal worth or actual future.

title.en: Character context and this edition’s limited reading

This edition selects pausing to question an initial assumption without certifying fictional Force, longevity or wisdom in respondents. Speech, size, age and species are not inputs; Grogu is not another name for Yoda. A pause here leaves room for an ordinary question rather than a meditation, spiritual-training or psychological-intervention method.

paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to ask why a method seems self-evident or which unchecked premise supports it. Does the assumption affect the choice, and can available material answer? Counts cannot establish that or prove depth. Familiar methods may still fit, and a pause may reveal nothing new. Questioning requires neither dismantling every rule nor becoming a guide to someone else’s thoughts.

title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.en: While reading ordinary material privately, question an assumption that you must go from first page to last. Do you want one topic, or does the material require sequence? Keep necessary order or choose a passage. The example separates purpose, conditions and assumptions without certifying wisdom through rejecting convention, sounding profound or appearing calm, and supplies no universally superior method of reading or thinking.

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我先停一下，看看为什么默认要这样；也可能原来的做法仍然合适。”与人共做时，说明自己的疑问，不用神秘口吻否定对方。对方可以不想讨论，你也能暂时不知道；角色不要求每个问题都有格言答案，不把不同看法当作缺少觉悟，也不用暂停来回避已同意的实际责任。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want to pause and see why this seemed necessary; the original approach may still fit.” Express a question without a mysterious tone dismissing someone else. Accept no interest in discussion and your own uncertainty. A character requires no proverb for every question, makes no different view a lack of enlightenment and uses no pause to evade actual responsibilities you already accepted.

Highest ties indicate no Force level, actual species or life stage and prescribe no order in which somebody must learn or mature.

Counts certify no wisdom, prediction, meditation, patience, calmness, neurotype, health or psychology and explain no actual symptom through fictional visions. question.zh: 需要看过电影、生日或照片吗？
question.en: Do I need film knowledge, a birthday or a photo?

answer.zh: 不需要，也不收生日或照片。21题是普通自选做法，没有剧情答对、外貌、身体或种族输入，也不检测原力。结果页提供理解本版有限读法的基础背景，不替代作品或现实心理评估。
answer.en: No, and no birthday or photo is collected. Twenty-one items concern ordinary chosen approaches without correct trivia answers, appearance, bodily or species input or Force detection. Basic context supports limited readings rather than replacing the work or actual psychological assessment.

question.zh: 怎样计分、处理最高并列与近分？
question.en: How are counts, highest ties and close choices handled?

answer.zh: 21题全部各选一项，对应的本版角色读法加1，总数固定21。每题提供七位中的四位，全卷每位出现12次、每位置3次；未提供的三位不记拒绝。所有最高计数逐份保留完整说明，全选第一项会七位各3次、七份完整显示。顺序不设主次，不自动指定第二角色；原始次数不是相似百分比、真实人格比例、原力、善恶或人口排名。相差一次只是一项选择，不证明显著差异、隐藏身份或固定类型。近分可自行比较，不补造并列、能力、阵营或种族。条件和理解可以改变选择，本版没有常模、稀有度、科学分界或心理测量验证。
answer.en: Choose one option for all 21 items; each adds one to its editorial character reading and counts sum to 21. Four of seven characters are offered per item. Each appears twelve times and three times in each position; three absent options are not rejections. Every highest count keeps its full guide. Choosing the first option throughout gives three each and all seven guides. List order establishes no priority or automatic second character. Counts are neither similarity percentages, actual personality proportions, the Force, good-versus-evil nor population ranks. One extra choice proves no significance, hidden identity or fixed type. Read close guides without inventing ties, powers, alignments or species. Conditions and understanding can change choices; this edition has no norms, rarity estimates, scientific cutoffs or psychometric validation.

question.zh: 这是官方、心理病理或科学人格测试吗？
question.en: Is this official, psychopathology or a scientific personality test?

answer.zh: 这是费马独立创作的21题非官方同人问卷，选用在《星球大战》原版三部曲出现的汉·索罗、帕尔帕廷、达斯·维达、莱娅、欧比旺、卢克和尤达七位虚构角色，只作普通自选做法的有限阅读角度，不代表完整人格、全作品阵容或官方分类。维达与阿纳金、帕尔帕廷与西迪厄斯各保留一个身份，不增加角色或测试；官方总传记包含其他时期，不因此将所有时期的行为一概投射到答题者。题目、选项、映射、计数、解释与例子原创，未采用IDR35题、竞品正文／算法、其他价值或病理问卷、电影截图、立绘、台词、字幕、歌词或其他受保护素材。不是Disney或Lucasfilm官方测验，无权利人合作、授权或认可；作品、角色和STAR WARS商标归相应权利人。官方Databank仅核角色基本语境和身份，不验证本站题目、计分或心理解释。中文名为本版编辑采用写法，英文身份稳定。结果不推断原力、心理病理、疾病、智商、道德、危险性、残障、身体、物种、族群、性别、年龄、创伤、爱情、关系、职业或政治信念，不指导战争、武器、操控、虐待、呼吸、冥想或战斗练习，也不换算MBTI或其他测评。
answer.en: This is an independently authored FermatMind 21-item unofficial fan quiz selecting seven characters appearing in the original Star Wars trilogy: Han, Palpatine, Vader, Leia, Obi-Wan, Luke and Yoda. They support limited readings of ordinary chosen approaches rather than complete personalities, the entire franchise cast or an official taxonomy. Vader and Anakin retain one identity, as do Palpatine and Sidious, adding no characters or tests. Official biographies include other periods without projecting every period’s behaviour onto respondents. Items, options, mappings, counts, explanations and examples are original. No IDR 35-item bank, competitor text or algorithm, other values or psychopathology instrument, film stills, character art, dialogue, subtitles, lyrics or other protected material is used. This is no official Disney or Lucasfilm test or rights-holder partnership, authorisation or endorsement; respective owners retain works, characters and STAR WARS trademarks. Official Databank pages check basic context and identities without validating these items, counts or psychology. Chinese names are editorial choices retaining English identities. Results infer no Force, psychopathology, illness, IQ, morality, dangerousness, disability, bodily condition, species, ethnicity, gender, age, trauma, romance, relationship, career or political belief, instruct no war, weapons, manipulation, abuse, breathing, meditation or combat practice, and convert into no MBTI or other assessment.

question.zh: 完整结果、重测与分享免费吗？
question.en: Are full results, retaking and sharing free?

answer.zh: 免费，无需注册、邮箱或先做另一测试。可先读七份完整说明，完成21题后最高并列全部完整显示。重测清除本次选择，可选分享不含答案或次数。后续MBTI另行作答，不从角色换算，也不是解锁结果的条件。
answer.en: They are free without signup, email or another test first. Read seven full guides before answering; every highest tie appears after all 21 choices. Retaking clears this attempt. Optional sharing contains no answers or counts. Further MBTI questions require new responses rather than conversion and do not unlock these results.
